Norwich drinks from a river 💧
Part of Norwich's tap water is taken from the River Wensum at Heigham. The East of England is the driest region in the UK, with about two thirds of the national average rainfall (approximately 600mm a year). Heigham's 100+ year old treatment works had a £36 million upgrade that added the UK's largest ever submerged ultrafiltration plant.
